set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- No shape product, suffix product, endpoint, word-count, or sample-offset computation relies on overflowing Int arithmetic.
- Sample-to-word addressing uses codesPerWord division and slot calculation rather than high-range sample-times-bits multiplication.
- Positive shapes whose products exceed Int storage limits fail before allocation.
- Boundary tests exercise Int.MaxValue products, word-count rounding, offset transforms, and narrow endpoints without enormous allocations.
- One shared checked planner is used by immutable and mutable packed arrays.
- JVM and Scala.js behavior agrees.
set.title: Use checked packed shape, stride, offset, and word arithmetic
